title: fix(electron): normalize test path expectations for Windows compatibility

commits.message:
fix(electron): normalize test path expectations for Windows compatibility

On Windows, path.join() produces backslash-separated paths (\), but
LinkIndex.normalizeSlashes always returns forward-slash paths (/).
This caused 9 of 15 tests in sample-vault.test.ts to fail on Windows
with assertion errors like:

  expected 'C:/.../Topics/AI.md' to be 'C:\\...\\Topics\\AI.md'

The production code normalization is correct; this aligns all
path.join() call sites in the test file with that behavior by
wrapping them with normalizeSlashes(), starting from VAULT_ROOT
itself so derived paths are consistently forward-slash formatted.

Fixes #77
